mathematical_audit.determinant: For C=[[-a,-Q0],[1,0]], det(C)=Q0 and chi_C(X)=X^2+aX+Q0. Thus the determinant is exactly the already forced transverse coordinate and is not a new condition.
mathematical_audit.lisse_scope: A lisse mod-p Frobenius acts invertibly on every unramified fiber. The actual Q0=0 row therefore excludes a literal all-row lisse realization of this companion; deleting that divisor would delete the target event.
mathematical_audit.product_scope: The determinant of a pointwise product is multiplicatively separable in independently varying local factors. The operator F F_xy-F_x F_y vanishes on f(x)g(y) but equals -1 on x+y, proving only the declared universal local-product obstruction.
mathematical_audit.crystalline_scope: Within the explicitly fixed-normalization full-determinant class, det(Phi)=p^mu times a unit gives uniformly unit or uniformly zero reduction. The mixed Q0 controls rule out that full-determinant model, while Hasse subdeterminants and varying-slope or singular models remain open.
mathematical_audit.conductor: The finite logarithm has degree p-1 and root multiplicity at most two, so its z^2 pullback has at least p-2 distinct roots. Literal full-order Kummer support and literal Artin-Schreier Swan conductor therefore grow linearly with p.
